build_votenet_model: build a VoteNet model for 3D object detection in point clouds with hough voting
run_votenet_forward: run a forward pass of VoteNet on a point cloud input dictionary
create_votenet_pointnet2: create a VoteNet instance using the pointnet2 backbone for point feature learning

test_votenet_inference: test VoteNet inference on a sample point cloud and print all end points
